rationale: The imported PMID:19129623 studies ATCC35851/pKSL/AB449340, not FXJ1.172/KT591188.1. The inspected 2011 producer study identifies FXJ1.172 product as lasalocid A by mass, UV and MS2 comparison to JCM3373; it does not independently determine absolute stereochemistry or characterize the entire deposited cluster. Route the locus claim to KT591188.1, a putative partial BGC submission, not to the AB449340 experiment. Preserve source-tier grades and original raw references; no taxon, chemistry or locus-coordinate change. See issue #972.

The pinned entry places DOI:10.1021/ic9016883 only under compound bioactivity and PMID:26452553 at entry level. Route the entry reference to the CA producer and CP005094.1 locus; preserve the bioactivity citation in its original source context. The 2016 abstract concerns the Azotobacter chelome, but full-text experimental attribution remains incomplete. No evidence grade is upgraded or exact coordinate experiment asserted. See issue #931.

The inspected version-3 entry places DOI:10.1016/0048-4059(78)90029-2 only under compound bioactivity and PMID:28535078 at entry level; KY656140.1 also cites PMID:28535078. Route the entry reference to producer and locus while retaining the original bioactivity context. The inspected primary abstract reports production in a C. zeina transformant complemented with C. zeae-maydis CTB7, not demonstrated production by the unmodified deposited CTB7-pseudogene locus. Full-text and exact-product adjudication remain incomplete; no experimental grade is upgraded. Citation routing fixes #954; identity and claim-level engineering context remain open in #955 and #956.
